newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Huntsman Corp sells $400 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Huntsman Corp sells $400 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following $400 million two-part 144a private placement from Huntsman Corp was priced on Thursday via lead manager BT Securities Corp, according to market sources.

The deal consisted of a $275 million fixed-rate tranche, which was increased from an original size of $200 million. It also included a $125 million floating-rate tranche which was increased from an original size of $100 million.
